name: opencode-admission
description: OpenCode live admission bridge: a plugin whose before-tool-execution hook consults the shared admission ledger (over an HTTP loopback facade) for the built-in shell tool, proving feasibility experiment S2 (docs/integration-feasibility.md) and open decision D1 across disconnect, expiry, revocation, and Stop. Built for M1.9 (issue #20); depends on experiments/opencode-harness and experiments/shared through local file: dependencies, never modifying either.
